items.text: picks their nose at red lights and thinks nobody can see
leaves a hair in the sink and calls it a decoration
cracks every knuckle at the dinner table
eats the last biscuit and puts the empty packet back
sneezes into their hand, then high-fives everyone
only rinses the coffee mug and never washes it
wipes their sweaty face on the tea towel
uses the same towel for three weeks
trims their nails on the sofa and leaves the clippings there
leaves the bathroom fan off for the whole visit
eats the mould off the bread and says it's fine
keeps mouthwash for emergencies that never happen
dips toast into the shared jam with a used knife
burps the alphabet on purpose
claims it's not sweat after the gym, it's glow
leaves socks in the middle of the living room floor
shares every pimple update with the group chat
eats a dropped sandwich in five seconds and says it's clean
doesn't flush and claims the air freshener did the job
sucks a lollipop down to a stub, then bites it
stacks the dishes until the sink looks like a cave
forgets deodorant every second Monday
ignores the fridge smell for a week and blames the bin
licks the spoon before putting it back in the jar
pours the last of the milk without checking the date
wipes their hands on the car seat just this once
eats cold leftovers straight from the pan at 3am
wears the same earbuds all day and never cleans them
sniffs their gym bag and says it's fine
licks their plate clean before the washing up
falls asleep with half a croissant on the pillow
drinks from a stranger's bottle at the festival and calls it networking
hasn't washed their towel since the move into the flat
picks at a scab during the film and shows everyone
cuts their toenails on the train and calls it a quick job
